example: Leave it to Maria to explain the process clearly.
exampleZh: 把清楚解釋這個流程的工作交給瑪麗亞吧。

examples.en: Leave it to Maria to explain the process clearly.
examples.zh: 把清楚解釋這個流程的工作交給瑪麗亞吧。
examples.highlight: Leave it to Maria to explain the process clearly.

rules.zh: 第一個 to 後面是負責的人在這句中，負責修理機器的人是 the technician。
rules.en: Leave it to the technician to repair the machine.

rules.zh: 第二個 to 後面是要完成的動作第二個 to 後面使用動詞原形：【to explain；to organise；to repair；to answer；to investigate】
rules.en: Leave it to the technician to repair the machine. to explain to organise to repair to answer to investigate

rules.zh: 人稱代名詞要使用受詞形式交給我跟經理談吧。 把準備數字資料的工作交給他吧。 把接待客人的工作交給她吧。 把解決問題的工作交給我們吧。 把作出安排的工作交給他們吧。 不應使用：【Leave it to I ✘；Leave it to he ✘；Leave it to she ✘；Leave it to we ✘；Leave it to they ✘】
rules.en: Leave it to me to speak to the manager. Leave it to him to prepare the figures. Leave it to her to welcome the guests. Leave it to us to solve the problem. Leave it to them to make the arrangements. Leave it to I ✘ Leave it to he ✘ Leave it to she ✘ Leave it to we ✘ Leave it to they ✘

rules.zh: 必須清楚指出由誰完成第二個動作選擇菜單的人是廚師。準備海報的人是設計師。
rules.en: Leave it to the chef to choose the menu. Leave it to the designer to prepare the poster.

rules.zh: 不要混淆以下兩個結構把完成報告的工作交給艾瑪。 讓艾瑪獨自完成報告，不要打擾她。 第二句沒有 it，意思較接近「不要干涉她」或「讓她自行處理」，並不是本課的目標句型。
rules.en: Leave it to Emma to complete the report. Leave Emma to complete the report.

rules.zh: 目標表達【Leave it up to someone to...】是相關句型，但不屬於本課核心形式這個句型正確，但本練習只集中訓練：【leave it to + person + to + verb】
rules.en: Leave it up to someone to... Leave it up to the committee to decide. leave it to + person + to + verb

rules.zh: 目標表達【Leave it to someone】本身可以完整，但本練習要求加入動作交給我吧。 這句正確，但本練習要求學生清楚說出要負責的動作：【Leave it to me to contact the supplier.】 把聯絡供應商的工作交給我吧。
rules.en: Leave it to someone Leave it to me. Leave it to me to contact the supplier.

benefits.zh: 清楚說明由誰負責這個句型能把負責的人和要完成的工作放在同一句中。把聯絡客人的工作交給接待員。 讀者可以立即知道：誰負責：the receptionist 負責做甚麼：contact the guests
benefits.en: Leave it to the receptionist to contact the guests.

benefits.zh: 表示對某人的能力有信心這個句型經常表示說話者相信某人有能力完成工作。你可以放心把整理檔案的工作交給克拉拉。 這句不只是說克拉拉會做，也帶有「她能夠處理好」的意思。
benefits.en: You can leave it to Clara to organise the files.

benefits.zh: 把較長的解釋說得更直接與其說「技術員應該負責修理機器」，你可以直接說「把修理機器的工作交給技術員」，語氣更自然直接。
benefits.en: Instead of: The technician should be responsible for repairing the machine. You can say: Leave it to the technician to repair the machine.

benefits.zh: 適合分配團隊工作這個句型可以用於會議、活動、工作項目和日常安排，清楚分配不同責任。把準備海報的工作交給設計團隊。 把檢查成本的工作交給財務主任。
benefits.en: Leave it to the design team to prepare the poster. Leave it to the finance officer to check the costs.

benefits.zh: 可以表達建議、決定或警告使用不同的語法外殼，可以改變句子的語氣。我們應該把決定交給專家。 他們把選擇路線的工作交給導遊。 不要把修理電線的工作交給未受訓練的人。
benefits.en: We should leave it to the experts to decide. They left it to the guide to choose the route. Do not leave it to an untrained person to repair the wires.

benefits.zh: 讓說話和寫作不再只依賴簡單的「X should do it」學生經常只會使用：【The manager should do it.】 使用本句型後，可以更清楚地說明責任分配：【Leave it to the manager to make the announcement.】 把公布消息的工作交給經理。 這使句式更有變化，也更適合真實的工作和團隊溝通。
benefits.en: The manager should do it. The teacher should do it. The technician should do it. Leave it to the manager to make the announcement.

questions.prompt: You do not need to explain the process to the new staff. I will do it.

questions.prompt: If you need medical advice, online strangers should not decide what treatment you need.

questions.prompt: Before the reporters arrived, we had already asked the official spokesperson to answer their questions.

questions.highlight: By the time the reporters arrived, we had left it to the official spokesperson to answer their questions.

questions.prompt: The company will probably ask the human resources manager to settle the disagreement.

questions.prompt: The director clearly stated that the research team would verify every figure before publication.
questions.promptZh: 主管清楚表示，會由研究團隊在發布前核實每個數字。
questions.answer: The director made it clear that she would leave it to the research team to verify every figure before publication.

questions.prompt: For many years, the neighbours have relied on Mr Wong to organise the annual clean-up.
questions.promptZh: 多年來，鄰居一直依靠黃先生籌辦每年的清潔活動。
questions.answer: The neighbours have always left it to Mr Wong to organise the annual clean-up.
questions.answerZh: 鄰居一直把籌辦每年清潔活動的工作交給黃先生。
questions.highlight: The neighbours have always left it to Mr Wong to organise the annual clean-up.

questions.prompt: Junior staff should not handle the final contract. The senior negotiator should manage the discussions.
questions.promptZh: 初級職員不應處理最終合約，相關磋商應該由資深談判員負責。
questions.answer: We ought to leave it to the senior negotiator to manage the discussions rather than expect the junior staff to handle the final contract.
questions.answerZh: 我們應該把管理磋商的工作交給資深談判員，而不是要求初級職員處理最終合約。
questions.highlight: We ought to leave it to the senior negotiator to manage the discussions rather than expect the junior staff to handle the final contract.

questions.prompt: Who was chosen to speak to the union? Farah was given responsibility for the discussion.
questions.promptZh: 誰獲選與工會商談？法拉獲安排負責這次討論。
questions.answer: They left it to Farah to speak to the union.
questions.answerZh: 他們把與工會商談的工作交給法拉。
questions.highlight: They left it to Farah to speak to the union.
